name: Aletta

videos.title: Vitestro - Aletta Autonomous Robotic Phlebotomy Device

description: Aletta is an autonomous robotic phlebotomy device (ARPD), developed by Dutch medtech company Vitestro. Combining artificial intelligence, near-infrared imaging, and robotic ultrasound guidance, Aletta autonomously maps veins, performs venipuncture, and handles blood collection tubes under the supervision of a trained phlebotomist. The system received CE mark approval in 2024 and FDA De Novo marketing authorization in 2026.

publications.title: Performance, Safety, and Patient Experience of an Autonomous Robotic Phlebotomy Device: A Multicenter Trial
